t0.text: Yuu · Long-stay Thailand guide · Design canvas

t2.text: 01 Home · Direction A Visa Desk (chosen) · Direction B Night Guide

h1.text:
Handoff · Design system
Tokens live in project/yuu.css as CSS variables. Ship them as-is.
One font: Anuphan variable (Latin + Thai), weights 400 to 700. Thai copy for providers needs no second font.
Light mode only at launch. The night tokens exist only for Direction B.
Every status pairs color with an icon and a word. Never color alone.
Focus: 3px teal outline, 2px offset, on every interactive element.
Tap targets 44px minimum. Body text 17px. Nothing below 14px.
Prices: THB first, tabular numbers. Converted value is secondary, marked ≈, with the rate date.

h2.text:
Handoff · 01 Home → /
Hero stacks under 900px. Browse grid: 2 columns mobile, 5 desktop.
Alert banner shows the newest rule change under 30 days old. Dismiss stores the change id locally.
Trust strip data: verified_provider_count, embassy_report_count, rules_last_checked_at.
What changed: 3 latest rule_changes (effective_date, title, affects, source_url, checked_at).
Browse tiles link to /[activity]/[city]. Counts from published programs only.
Empty: hide a tile with 0 programs. Error: show the strip without counts.
Direction B (00B) is the alternative, kept for reference.

h3.text:
Handoff · 02 Route checker → /check, /check/results
8 steps, one question per screen: passport, apply-from country, income source, savings range, activity, city, length, family.
Answers save locally on every tap. Reload resumes at the last step. No account.
Back keeps answers. Progress = step / 8.
Apply-from defaults to the passport country but allows legal residence elsewhere.
Results rank routes Strong, Possible, Not a fit. Each needs route_id, verdict, one-line reason, embassy notes (text, source_url, checked_at).
Checklist comes from route + embassy. Items are checkable and saved.
Save = share link with answers in the URL hash. Email sends the same link.
Desktop results: 2 columns, checklist column sticky.

h4.text:
Handoff · 03 Listing → /[activity]/[city], e.g. /muay-thai/phuket
Mobile: full filters in a bottom sheet, quick chips in a sticky bar. Desktop: left rail.
List / Map toggle keeps filters. Map clusters pins under zoom 12.
Sort: best match (default), price, most approvals reported, fastest reply.
Card data: name, area, verification_state + date, price_month_thb, total for the selected length, min_months, documents_count of 5, approvals_reported, rejections_reported, median_reply_hours, is_partner.
Compare: max 4. Tray stays visible on scroll. A 5th add shows an inline message.
Empty: empty state with one-tap filter removals. Loading: 3 skeleton cards.
Partner listings carry the Partner label everywhere.

h5.text:
Handoff · 04 Provider → /p/[slug]
Verification panel: body, reference_no, verified_at, method. Links to /methodology.
Cost calculator: months × monthly price + DTV fee 10,000 THB + insurance estimate + optional accommodation. Recomputes on change. THB / USD / EUR toggle uses a daily rate with its date.
Embassy outcomes: grouped by embassy and month, with proof count. Hide rows under 2 reports.
Reviews: only students with a verified enrollment.
Mobile: sticky CTA plus WhatsApp and LINE. Desktop: CTA in the sticky right card.
Suspended: hide CTAs, show the suspended banner with reason and date.

h6.text:
Handoff · 05 Compare → /compare?ids=a,b,c
2 to 4 providers. Rows: price, length, documents, accreditation, approvals reported, accommodation, reply time.
Show differences only hides rows where every value matches.
A differing row gets a Differs tag and bold values. Never color alone.
Mobile: 2 columns visible, scroll sideways for 3 and 4. Row labels stay pinned left.
Remove from the column header. With 1 left, show Add another.

h7.text:
Handoff · 06 Embassy → /embassy/[country]/[city], e.g. /embassy/uk/london
Requirements table: every row has source_url and checked_at. Rows older than 60 days show Needs recheck.
Quirks: dated callouts. Rules under 30 days old get a New tag.
Processing time: median and range from reports in the last 90 days.
Outcomes timeline: monthly approved and rejected counts, labelled on the bars.
Report your outcome: 3 steps, draft saved locally. Proof optional (image or PDF, 10 MB). Moderation within 2 working days. Status: Pending, Published, Rejected with reason.

h8.text:
Handoff · 07 Enquiry → /enquire/[provider], /enquire/done/[code]
Fields: name, email, channel (WhatsApp or LINE) + handle, start month, program, embassy. Pre-fill from checker answers.
Consent 1 (share with up to 3 providers) is optional. Without it, only the chosen provider gets the enquiry. Consent 2 (alerts) is optional and unticked.
Draft saves locally on each field blur. Offline: banner shows and Send queues.
Confirmation: reference code, timeline with the provider's median reply time, deep links wa.me/[number]?text=[code] and LINE oaMessage with [code].
Error: keep inputs, show a field message and a retry.

h9.text:
Handoff · 08 Rule changes → /changes
Entry: effective_date, title, what_changed, who_it_affects, source_name, source_url, checked_at, type (Official, Embassy notice, Correction).
Filter chips by type and route. Newest first.
Subscribe: email plus optional embassy and route. Double opt-in.
Feed at /changes.xml for partners.

h10.text:
Handoff · 09 Guide → /guides/[slug]
Parts: title, summary, key facts box, contents (auto from H2), body with numbered source footnotes, last reviewed date + reviewer name and role, related providers (3, by activity and city).
Desktop: contents sticky in the left column. Mobile: contents collapse under the title.
Every factual claim carries a footnote. Past 90 days since review, show Review due.

h11.text:
Handoff · 10 Providers → /providers, /portal/inbox
Landing has one action: Claim your listing. Price per qualified enquiry stays a placeholder until set.
Qualified = valid contact, start within 6 months, budget and length inside the provider's range, route fits.
Portal inbox opens from a LINE notification. Card: fit summary, Accept, Decline (reason required), one-tap LINE or WhatsApp reply with the code.
Decline reasons: full, wrong level, wrong length, can't reach, spam. Can't reach and spam open a dispute and are not billed.
Statement: qualified count, disputed count, amount due. Thai / English toggle on every portal screen.

h12.text:
Handoff · 11 Admin → /admin/leads
Columns: New, Qualified, Sent, Accepted, Enrolled, Disputed. Drag to move. Every move logs who and when.
Card: reference code, lead, provider, route, embassy, age in hours.
SLA flag when a Sent lead has no provider reply in 24 hours.
Desktop only.
